card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS warning text
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word, or a comma, inside text written in all capitals, such as boxed warnings. It often falls on endings like S in PATIENTS or V in HBV.

modes.label: Word endings in caps
modes.description: Plural or word-ending pieces of capitalized warning words such as PATIENTS, CASES or CELLS.
modes.example: GIVEN WITH CAUTION TO PATIENT<<S>> WITH TYPE I HYPERSENSITIVITY

modes.label: Capitalized disease acronym
modes.description: The last letter of an acronym such as HBV in a capitalized boxed-warning heading.
modes.example: EXACERBATIONS OF HB<<V>> All patients with HIV-1 should be

modes.label: Comma or solution word in caps
modes.description: A comma or a following word within an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: SOMETIMES ASSOCIATED WITH DEATH<<,>> ARE STRONGLY ASSOCIATED WITH
